description: Extract language and name from Language-Scoped Toponym (LST) format (name@lang), preserving original. Appends @und if no language specified.

script.source: if (ctx.toponym_id != null) { if (!ctx.toponym_id.contains('@')) { ctx.toponym_id = ctx.toponym_id + '@und'; } String[] parts = ctx.toponym_id.splitOnToken('@'); if (parts.length == 2) { ctx.name = parts[0]; ctx.name_lower = parts[0].toLowerCase(); String langPart = parts[1]; if (langPart.contains('-')) { String[] langParts = langPart.splitOnToken('-'); ctx.lang = langParts[0]; ctx.lang_variant = langParts[1]; } else { ctx.lang = langPart; } } }
